title: Binance Now Supports Limit Buy Orders When Buying Crypto Using Credit/Debit Card
text: This is a general announcement. Products and services referred to here may not be available in your region. Fellow Binancians, We are pleased to announce that users can now place  Limit Buy  orders as part of “Buy Crypto” service on Binance. Users can access this feature when purchasing crypto in their local currencies with their credit or debit cards through the ‘Buy Crypto’ function. This new feature is available on both Binance website and the Binance Pro App. With Limit Buy orders, users can set the maximum price they are willing to pay for a given crypto asset, and orders are only executed within the desired parameters. This broadens the options of order types available when buying crypto with fiat on Binance, catering to users’ different trading preferences. Place Limit Buy Orders How to Place Limit Buy Orders: Log in to your Binance account on the Binance website or Binance Pro App.   Go to the “Buy Crypto” page, choose which crypto to buy and the payment method. Select  [Limit Buy] . Place a limit buy order instead of buying at the current market price. Enter the Target Price at which you'd like to buy. Follow the instructions to complete your order. For more detailed step-by-step guidance, please refer to  this FAQ .  Notes:   Users must update their Binance App to iOS version 2.100.0, or Android 2.100.0 or above to see the option of Limit Buy Order.  Terms and conditions apply . There may be discrepancies between this original content in English and any translated versions. Please refer to the original English version for the most accurate information, in case any discrepancies arise. Thank you for your support! Binance Team 2025-05-28
